findings.message: `saveOrder(order)` is not awaited, so the handler returns 201 before the order is persisted. A failed save becomes an unhandled rejection, and the client is told the order exists when it may not.
The new express-checkout handler creates an order without checking or recording the signed-in user. Anyone can create orders, and they are not tied to their owner.
`req.body` is cast straight to `Cart` without validation. A client can send malformed data or its own item prices and totals, and these flow unchecked into the saved order.
